description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer word-boundary checkpoint: safe Rust owns host-style exclusive word boundaries, separator-to-previous-word behavior, and optional leading-zero trimming while preserving 0x, 0X and 0n prefixes.

entries.notes: screen_word_boundary operates directly on safe TextBuffer row storage, returns the host's exclusive end coordinate, reproduces front/middle/end queries including the one-past-row endpoint, and maps a query on the separator after 'some' to the word immediately to its left.

With trim-leading-zeros enabled, the Rust owner removes redundant leading zeroes from Microsoft's 000fe12 and 0Nfe12 vectors while preserving recognized 0x, 0X and 0n prefixes and the exact exclusive endpoints.
With trimming disabled, all five Microsoft source vectors retain their complete regular-character runs and exact exclusive endpoints.
